Depth in bone is a SIGNED SURFACE DISTANCE on the real bone mesh (trimesh ProximityQuery), not an inside/outside flag on a voxel solid -- Q307 S1 measured a voxel solid inflated to 116.7 cm3 against 93.8 for the mesh, which nearly produced a false finding.
